summary: Navigated fresh to http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/dfza7can2xjpcd/vgr2v-n1-bench-dashboard (retried 3× to clear parameters). The dashboard loads in normal view mode (Share/Edit buttons, no exit-edit controls). Observed: (1) address bar — Grafana itself re-appends its state on every load, so after each clean navigation the bar reads http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/dfza7can2xjpcd/vgr2v-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m; I cleared/reloaded three times and the same four parameters return immediately (flagged as Grafana URL-state sync, not something the UI lets me suppress). (2) Panels visible: "vgr2v-n1 Notes" (Text, paragraph "Bench notes for run vgr2v-n1") and "vgr2v-n1 Availability" (Stat, showing 91.8). (3) Top-bar time range picker: "Last 6 hours". (4) Auto-refresh picker: "1m" (aria-label confirms "current interval 1 minute selected"). (5) Tag: opened Edit > Dashboard settings > General and the Tags list shows the chip "bench" with a "Remove \"bench\" tag" button. Screenshot captured of the view-mode dashboard.
